// createGapInstances is mentioned in this comment only, which does not count.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { decideGapsForPolicy } from "@/lib/gap-detection"

export async function read(policyId: string) {
    const rows = await db.gapInstance.findMany({ where: { policyId, supersededAt: null } })
    return { rows, decide: decideGapsForPolicy }
}
